sourceSentences: [0] In spider form, her Q is a point-and-click ability which dashes her to the target, dealing damage to them, scaling with their missing health.

[0] Her human form E is a straightline skill shot which stuns the first target hit. In spider form, it causes her to lift up into the air and become unargetable. After 2 seconds, she will naturally come back down where she left. Or if this ability is recast on an enemy, she'll instead come down on top of them.
[0] And the main thing to make or break your ganks is landing that cocoon.
[0] For matchups, Elise is amazing into squishier junglers who she can cocoon and one-shot.
[0] From here, a zas into your spider E is a great way to keep yourself safe, wait for cool downs, and go for another target.
[1] Use spider form to finish off enemies with low health, while human form's Neurotoxin is more effective against high-health targets.
[1] Lee Sin will easily be killed if he is stunned with your cocoon.
[DDragon enemytips] Rappel will only move Elise straight up and down unless she can descend upon an enemy unit.
[DDragon enemytips] Rappel has a long cooldown. Elise is vulnerable after she has used it.
